rationale: Mufaddal's 15+ years of embedded systems expertise—particularly in connectivity, OTA updates, and automotive-grade software—directly complements Era's focus on edge intelligence and on-device AI infrastructure. As Edge scales sovereign AI and privacy-preserving hardware, Mufaddal's deep embedded Linux and firmware background could help bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI models and real-world hardware constraints that currently limit edge deployment.
intro_message: Mufaddal, meet Era Qian — she's building edge AI infrastructure for on-device deployment, and your embedded systems and connectivity expertise could be valuable as Edge tackles the hardware-software integration challenges in sovereign, privacy-preserving AI.
